image_description: A vintage-style photograph showing two musicians playing bassoons. In the foreground, a young woman with long blonde hair holds a bassoon diagonally across her body, fingers positioned on the keys. In the background, an older man in a suit also plays a bassoon. The instruments feature dark reddish-brown wood, silver metal keywork, and curved metal bocals. Sheet music is visible on a stand in the lower left.
